{{Quote|This predator lunged out of a still pool and dragged one of our team members under before we could effect a rescue. The body was never recovered.|[[Halka Four-Den/Legends|Halka Four-Den]] speaks about a scrange on [[Dagobah/Legends|Dagobah]]|<ref name="The Illustrated Star Wars Universe">''[[The Illustrated Star Wars Universe]]''</ref>}}
The '''scrange''' was a large tusk-tailed [[Reptile/Legends|reptile]] that lived in the muddy [[Swamp/Legends|swamps]] of [[Dagobah/Legends|Dagobah]].

==Description==
[[File:Scrange_swemp20.jpg|thumb|left|200px|A scrange attacks [[Prince/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] and [[Raal Panteer]]]]
The scrange was the apex predator of Dagobah, attacking its prey with a great ferocity. Scranges were beaked and had many bioluminescent patches on their body, arranged in a ridge along its spine. When prey got close, attracted by the lights, the scrange would lift out of the mud on its six crustacean-like hind legs to make a quick attack or it would use its four tail tusks to impale its prey.<ref name="NoP" />

Scranges somehow found their way to several [[Planet/Legends|worlds]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] [[Battle of Brentaal IV (Clone Wars)|Battle of Brentaal IV]], a scrange attacked [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] [[Shaak Ti/Legends|Shaak Ti]] and her crew of [[Quinlan Vos/Legends|Quinlan Vos]], [[Ryyk (Wookiee)|Ryyk]], and a [[Unidentified clone trooper (Brentaal IV)|clone trooper]]. The predator was able to kill Ryyk, but was killed by Ti when she pierced its head with her [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]].
